Hooked HUD "Big spender", read live 2026-09-15 (wave 43 opened only the first of the three). 662x64: both readouts 104 wide, left group (24,14) 264x36 with Balance 64 and Win 184 absolute, content closing at 288; right group 239x82 at 407, closing at 646 = 662 - 16. fitBar needs 574 for those widths and grows to exactly that; the node is drawn at 662 with 119 of slack, so the frames fix WHERE the bar must grow and not a width to grow to - which parts.ts already says and this read confirms. Every other offset is the shared ladder. Same two residuals.
